items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 69:1
items.html: After all the aspects of the Katnut of YESHSUT were completed, they rose as MAN to upper AVI for the inclusion of the coupling within them, for the need of the Mochin of Gadlut, as is known, in all the Partzufim. And it is known that every illumination comes only from Ein Sof, and therefore, at the time when YESHSUT rose as MAN to upper AVI, AVI likewise raised MAN to their own upper one, and that upper one to the one above it, until the Rosh of AK, which receives the aspect of new light from Ein Sof upon the MAN raised to it, and there comes out a level of ten Sefirot upon this MAN, called Mochin, or the drop of the coupling and MAD; and these Mochin descend from Partzuf to Partzuf until they come to their first place, namely in the first Partzuf, which was the first to raise MAN, for whose sake the light of Ein Sof descended. Hence every drop of birth and new emanation is attributed to AB SAG of AK, which are the first to receive the light of Ein Sof.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 69:2
items.html: And therefore, when these Mochin reached Atik, and it too coupled from the aspect of these Mochin in its Yesod and Atara, all the Parsaot in Atzilut that came by force of the second restriction, namely by force of the rise of the bottom Hey in Einayim, as is known, were then breached; and then the Yesod of Atik was breached as well, since the screen of the Yesod of Atik makes AA into a Partzuf separate from it, on account of the rise of the bottom Hey to Einayim. (As above, page 726, Act 8) And now AA and Atik became one Partzuf.
